topic: why the annual Costco membership fee is about half of what Costco earns in operating income
storyAngle: Costco sells almost everything cheaply; the membership card is where the profit comes from.
doNotClaim: Do not say Costco sells at zero profit or at a loss.
Do not compare fees to net income; compare to operating income only.

facts.claim: Costco FY2024 MEMBERSHIP FEE REVENUE (what members paid in annual fees) was $4,828 million.
Costco FY2024 OPERATING INCOME (profit from operations) was $9,285 million.
Costco FY2024 total revenue was $254,453 million.
Annual fees rose on Sept 1 2024: Gold Star/Business from $60 to $65, Executive from $120 to $130.

derived.claim: Membership fee revenue was about 52% of Costco operating income.
